name: Those Days
source:
It is called "Those Days" and it is about a guy that decides that he will be spending a few days in his family's farmhouse. There he meets Cott, Salmi, and later on a few other characters that will make his vacation a bit more interesting.

[From [url=https://thecastr.itch.io/those-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
它被称为“那些日子”，讲述的是一个人决定在他家的农舍里度过几天的故事。在那里，他遇到了科特、萨尔米，后来又遇到了其他一些角色，这将使他的假期变得更加有趣。

[来自[url=https://thecastr.itch.io/those-days]Itch.io[/url]]
